event.text: A Counsel clinician can review your STI panel in this thread and explain what that value means, including whether any treatment or repeat testing is needed; please share the result name and number. If you develop fever, pelvic or belly pain, genital sores, or unusual discharge before you hear back, seek same-day medical care.
